formula: sum(base_weight * reliability_factor * score) / sum(base_weight * reliability_factor) over usable modules only; missing reliability counts as medium
note: Reliability factors, the disagreement threshold, the minimum-module rule, the risk bands (low < 0.35, medium < 0.70, high >= 0.70) and the 0.35 label threshold are software settings, not clinically validated cut-offs.
